desc: Derive reduction: answer = (T + D)/2 with T = sum over ordered pairs f(A_i+A_j), D = sum_i f(A_i); f(x)=x - sum_{t>=1} x/2^t * [2^t | x].

Implement residue-class solution: parse input, compute S0=2*N*sum(A) and diagonal D=sum of odd parts; for each t with 2^t<=2*maxA build residue dicts (count,sum) mod 2^t, match r with (-r)%2^t, accumulate St, then T -= St//2^t; output (T+D)//2.
Sanity/performance check: dict-based residue approach runs within time for N=2e5 and t up to 24; complexity O(N*K) ~ 5e6 operations; no arrays of size 2^t.
